### Do You Know What God Wants You to Do? - Love Worth Finding - January 22
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-january-22-2022.html
Passage: Acts 5:20
Points:
- True Christian obedience must be informed by hearing clearly from God.
- The apostles acted with confidence because they had direct instruction from the Lord.
- Believers should not run ahead in self-willed efforts under the guise of Christian service.
- God does not promise to bless endeavors that He Himself did not command.
- Christians must evaluate their daily actions and submit every area of life to His will.
